## Overview

This project analyses a just-in-time supply chain dataset to
evaluate operational performance, identify bottlenecks, and
quantify supply chain risk — a key ESG consideration for
companies reporting under TCFD and GRI supply chain standards.

## Methodology

- **KPI analysis** — [lead time / on-time delivery / inventory
  turnover] across [N] suppliers and [N] SKUs
- **Risk indicators** — supplier concentration, geographic
  exposure, demand variability
- **[TIME SERIES / REGRESSION] analysis** — modelling
  [LEAD TIME / STOCKOUT RATE] as a function of
  [ORDER VOLUME / SUPPLIER TIER / SEASON]

## ESG Relevance

Supply chain resilience is a material ESG risk under:

- **GRI 204** — Procurement practices
- **TCFD** — Physical and transition climate risk in supply chains
- **CSRD** — Value chain due diligence
